subject: Recap & pricing follow-up — Redwood x Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmehealth.com>, Kristin Lee <kristin.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T14:05:00Z
Subject: Recap & pricing follow-up — Redwood x Acme Health

Hi Sanjay / Kristin,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really productive call. Quick recap and proposed next steps on pricing/commitment, so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of what you shared
- Primary use: clinical note summarization + search relevance for clinician workflows (pilot -> prod).
- Expected ramp: month 1 pilot ~50M tokens, month 3 ~200M tokens, steady-state target ~1.5B tokens/month within 12 months (batch + streaming mix).
- Current procurement timeline: decision by end of September; procurement/infosec sign-off early October.

Cost/qualification items we discussed
- Current target unit economics: ~ $350–450 per 1M tokens for production traffic (this is your target $/1M tokens range).
- Pilot budget: ~$20k–30k (covers pilot and evaluation).
- Preferred commercial structure: committed-use discount with multi-year incentives if volume growth assumptions hold.

What Redwood can offer (initial, not final):
- Startup Program: one-time onboarding credit + 15% off list for eligible early-stage companies (we included the one-pager attached).
- Committed-use pricing: for a 12-month commitment at your steady-state target (1.5B tokens/month), we can provide tiered discounts — ballpark example: 20% off list at $/1M tokens ≈ $420 (final depends on exact volume profile & model mix).
- Multi-year incentive: additional 5%–10% discount for 24–36 month contracts or performance-based ramp milestones.
- SOC2 + security: we’ll surface the SOC2 report and provide a redacted copy during procurement as requested.

Attachments: redwood_startup_program_1-pager.pdf, example_commitment_term_sheet.pdf (attached).

Next steps — please confirm:
1) Are the token ramp numbers above representative (pilot, month3, steady-state)?
2) If yes, we’ll run a short pricing model and share a committed-use term sheet (I’ve attached a template).
3) If you want to move forward with a 12/24/36-month commitment, we’ll prepare a DocuSign for signature and coordinate procurement/PO details.

If it helps, I can also prepare a worked example showing TCO at different $/1M token points (e.g., $300/$400/$500 per 1M tokens) to illustrate unit economics.

Thanks — looping Laura in for any special discount approvals on our end.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

--
Attachment: redwood_startup_program_1-pager.pdf (application/pdf - stub)
Attachment: example_commitment_term_sheet.pdf (application/pdf - stub)

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kristin Lee <kristin.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap & pricing follow-up — Redwood x Acme Health

Marissa — thanks for the detailed recap. The numbers look right to us; here are a couple clarifications from procurement/finance: 

- Pilot: we’ll lock ~50M tokens and evaluate for 4 weeks. Pilot budget confirmed at $25k.
- Steady-state: 1.5B tokens/month is our internal target if model accuracy checks out.
- Target unit economics: ideally $350 per 1M tokens for production. We recognize committed volume should get a lower unit price than pay-as-you-go.
- Procurement questions: what evidence do you need for the startup program? Also need a rough committed TCV for the 12-month proposal to start budget approval.

If you can send the worked TCO examples and a draft commitment term sheet with pricing tiers, we’ll review with finance and get back within 48 hours. Also, SOC2 is required — happy to accept a redacted copy as you mentioned.

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Data & Analytics, Acme Health
sanjay@acmehealth.com | (617) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap & pricing follow-up — Redwood x Acme Health

Thanks Sanjay — great, appreciate the clarity. Quick answers and next actions: 

- Startup program requirements: company stage (YC or < $10M ARR), simple form + incorporation docs + proof of funding if available. I’ve attached the one-pager which lists eligibility. If you want to pursue that track we can fast-track onboarding credits.
- Committed TCV: I’ll build a worked example for the 12-month and 24-month cases using three unit price points ($300/$400/$500 per 1M tokens) and return by EOD tomorrow.
- SOC2: Laura — can you share the latest SOC2 report (redacted) to attach to the procurement packet?

Laura — looping you for approval on the following proposed commercial levers: 
1) Startup program (if Acme qualifies) = 15% off list for first 3 months + onboarding credits.
2) 12-month committed discount example: 20% off list for baseline model mix at their steady-state expected volume.
3) 24+ month: additional 5%–10% rebate/incentive structured as step-down credits tied to ramp milestones.

Can we greenlight the 20%/12-month example to include in the term sheet I’ll send to Sanjay? If not, what final approval level is needed?

I’ll attach the worked TCO and a draft term sheet once Laura confirms.

Best,
Marissa

> On Aug 21, 2026, at 09:12, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> > Marissa — thanks for the detailed recap...

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acmehealth.com>, Kristin Lee <kristin.lee@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T16:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap & pricing follow-up — Redwood x Acme Health

Marissa — I’m OK to approve the 20% off list for a 12-month committed-use agreement as an initial commercial anchor, with the following conditions: 

1) Final pricing will be model-mix dependent — allow a +/- 5% adjustment if >60% of traffic is high-cost model variants.
2) Include a clause for quarterly volume review and a mechanism for step-up pricing if volume materially under-delivers vs committed forecast.
3) SOC2 redacted report must be in the procurement packet prior to signature.
4) For 24+ month commitments, we’ll add an additional 7% incentive (applied at contract execution if ramp milestones are met).

Marissa — please proceed to send the term sheet (include the DocuSign link). Sanjay — once signed we’ll intake PO/procurement details and coordinate SOC2 delivery.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
